title: Theorem 2.2 stated for a bipartite graph while Theorem D.3 proves only the simple case
basis: v1.5 inserts 'simple' into Theorem 2.2 in both languages. Verified true and necessary: Step 2's out-degree additivity requires that no other edge share both endpoints with e. title: Three standard steps left unstated in Appendix D
basis: v1.5 inserts all three in both languages: the reduced digraph is an induced subdigraph and hence kernel-perfect; the induction runs over bipartite graphs of maximum degree at most Delta; the two-colour subgraph has maximum degree at most two with u of degree one, so the alternating component is a well-defined simple path. Each verified true, correctly placed, sufficient, and free of new claims

title: Release package carries generically-named stale copies of version-specific evidence that shadow the current ones
basis: Two instances. (1) 03_reproducibility/manuscript_build_logs/LUALATEX_FINAL_en.log and _es.log build PAPER_III_preprint_draft_v1.3_*.tex and report 45/46 pages with 2 overfull boxes, contradicting the delivered 46/47-page v1.5 PDFs; the correct v1.5 logs sit one level below in manuscript_build_logs/v1.5/ under identical filenames. The sibling LUALATEX_{en,es}_PASS{1,2}.txt are likewise v1.3. (2) 03_reproducibility/MANUSCRIPT_CONSISTENCY_RESULTS.json records md_en sha256 eea753a4... which is the v1.4 English markdown, alongside the correct MANUSCRIPT_CONSISTENCY_RESULTS_v1.5.json recording a98e9313.... No release surface, manifest or QA report cites the stale copies and no claim depends on them, so nothing in the package asserts anything false; but a reader checking 'the final logs' or 'the consistency results' of a public release reaches a superseded artifact first. Non-mathematical
